No AI is used in this documentary. So enjoy knowing you're watching real content, by real storytellers and scientists! 

What makes whales a wonder of the deep? What characterizes their fascinating evolution, and various species? Learn more today, from Fayth Tan - this documentary's scientist writer, and storyteller.

Narrated by the fantastic Steve Taylor, a real voice you may find familiar!

Leo Richards, of @NaturalWorldFacts is also working with us closely to make these episodes beautiful, yet deeply scientific. 

Relax, enjoy, and learn about the Deep Sea!

Where did our universe truly come from? Has it always existed… or did it begin from nothing? And can science ever fully answer the question that first made us look up and wonder?

Welcome to the history of our universe, with Geraint F. Lewis, PhD as writer and Leo Richards from @NaturalWorldFacts as voiceover. 

00:00 - Prologue: How did it all begin?
04:37 - Chapter 1: The Scientists of the Big Bang Theory
14:12 - Chapter 2: A Day Without a Yesterday
20:24 - Chapter 3: The Great Physics Divide
30:02 - Chapter 4: Stars, Death, and Cosmic Recycling
40:06 - Chapter 5: Beyond Our Universe
1:02:17 - Chapter 6: The Cosmic Evolution Hypothesis

Where Did Our Universe Really Come From?

----------------------

If you want to dive deeper into the cosmos, don’t miss Geraint F. Lewis’ books. He’s the author behind this video — every word you heard was written by him. His writing truly shines on the page, and Where Did the Universe Come From? is a perfect place to start. Get your copy here: https://www.amazon.com/Where-Universe-Other-Cosmic-Questions-ebook/dp/B097GQQJG5

Life & The Universe is a new series, dedicated to exploring our universe with astronomers on the cutting edge. Created to be relaxing, immersive, and entertaining -- it’s for people new to astronomy, and those who have been in awe of our universe, and studied it for years. These are videos you can watch on TV, listen to, sleep to for 3 hours, or anything else!
